mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, and check in with how I feel before getting up.
mara.intention: Begin the day without rushing.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and get dressed for the market and nursery.
mara.intention: Get ready comfortably for errands.

mara.activity: Have a light breakfast at the kitchen island and make a short market list.
mara.intention: Eat before errands and decide what the kitchen needs.

mara.activity: Gather my tote and reusable shopping bags, put my keys in my pocket, and leave for the farmers market and nursery.
mara.intention: Leave prepared and keep the errands contained.

mara.activity: Shop at the farmers market and plant nursery, choosing produce and a few healthy plants, then return home.
mara.intention: Bring home fresh food and tend to the houseplants with a little renewed attention.

mara.activity: Put the groceries away, place the market herbs in a glass beside the kitchen sink, and have a brief pause at the island.
mara.intention: Settle the market things before the reset.

mara.activity: Wash produce, trim houseplants, wipe the kitchen surfaces, and reset the sink and island.
mara.intention: Restore a clean, workable kitchen and give the plants a careful check.

mara.activity: Make and eat a simple lunch at the island, then wash the bowl and mug.
mara.intention: Refuel before class without turning lunch into a project.

mara.activity: Change for ceramics, gather my notebook and water, and walk to class.
mara.intention: Shift out of household mode and arrive unhurried.

mara.activity: Attend the ceramics class and work through the exercise without trying to make the result client-ready.
mara.intention: Practice being a beginner and enjoy precision that allows for imperfection.

mara.activity: Walk home slowly and put my keys deliberately in the entryway while removing my shoes.
mara.intention: Let the class settle before returning to domestic tasks.

mara.activity: Make tea, read a few pages, and sketch garden ideas in the living room.
mara.intention: Keep my usual Saturday pause, with attention on ideas rather than work obligations.

mara.activity: Carry the mug and notebook to the kitchen, put the field notebook on the living room sideboard, and make a simple dinner plan for myself.
mara.intention: Acknowledge that Julian's evenings will be less predictable without waiting for dinner to organize itself around him.

mara.activity: Cook a simple vegetable and egg dinner at the island, then carry the plate to the living room.
mara.intention: Feed myself well while keeping the evening modest.

mara.activity: Eat quietly in the living room and notice what I am enjoying about the new ceramics routine.
mara.intention: Make space for the separate social world the class is giving me.

mara.activity: Carry the plate, fork, and glass to the kitchen, rinse them, and straighten the immediate counter space.
mara.intention: Close the kitchen gently rather than leaving a morning-sized task for tomorrow.

mara.activity: Take a warm shower, change into sleep clothes, and put my day clothes away.
mara.intention: Wind down physically after the long day.

mara.activity: Read in bed and exchange any necessary messages without trying to resolve the new schedule tonight.
mara.intention: Stay connected while allowing uncertainty to remain unfinished.

mara.activity: Place my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, set my phone beside them, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Make the room ready for sleep.

mara.activity: Sleep.
mara.intention: Rest before the next day.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, wash up, and make quiet coffee and a small breakfast at the kitchen island. I grind coffee beans, pour milk into a mug, and eat a banana while looking over the restaurant notebook without starting major planning.
julian.intention: Begin slowly and share a calm morning before the new schedule takes over.

julian.activity: Rinse the mug and breakfast things, wipe the island, and fill my thermos. I check my phone and send Mara a short message wishing her a good day without asking her to account for it.
julian.intention: Leave the kitchen ready and stay connected without making the morning emotionally demanding.

julian.activity: Collect my wallet and earplugs from the living room coffee table, take my keys from the piano middle shelf, pack my backpack, and dress in work clothes and kitchen clogs. I check that my spare restaurant shirt is available if the later schedule runs long.
julian.intention: Prepare for a longer, less predictable workday with as little rushing as possible.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant with my backpack and thermos.
julian.intention: Get in ahead of the shifted prep window.

julian.activity: Manage deliveries, receive and check stock, organize prep, and work through the kitchen opening list. I keep the restaurant notebook and pen nearby and use the knife roll for prep.
julian.intention: Establish control over the first day of the new schedule and prevent late service from becoming chaotic.

julian.activity: Take a brief meal and reset in the restaurant kitchen, drinking from the thermos and checking the service notes before the dining room opens later.
julian.intention: Eat before service so the longer evening does not run entirely on adrenaline.

julian.activity: Run the later dinner service and closing duties, coordinating the smaller team, checking dishes, and finishing the kitchen close.
julian.intention: Lead the first later service steadily while accepting that I will not have my usual Saturday evening at home.

julian.activity: Travel home, carry the thermos to the kitchen beside the sink, put my keys on the piano middle shelf, and leave my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table. I wash my hands and remove my jacket and clogs.
julian.intention: Put only the essential things away and make a quiet landing after closing.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, dry off, change into sleep clothes, and leave the towel hanging in the bathroom. I keep the lights low and do not turn on the television.
julian.intention: Let the heat and familiar sequence bring me down from service.

julian.activity: Eat a small bowl of yogurt and drink water, rinse the bowl and glass, and put my phone on its bedroom charger.
julian.intention: Have something gentle before bed without creating another task.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara without turning on the television and fall asleep as quietly as possible.
julian.intention: End the unusually late workday with rest rather than more planning.
